name: feeling
description: Feeling the Machine: study administration and the public site at feelingthemachine.com.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run budget && npm run legal && npm run audit

_check_comment: The one gate. Lint and the repo's own tests first (cheapest), then devkit's three delivered gates (budget, legal, audit; enrolled 2026-11-24, GO-LIVE F1). `headers.mjs` is delivered too and deliberately NOT here: it asserts a deployed response, so CI runs it after the deploy. CI runs `npm ci && npm run check`, then deploys `site/` from the same job. There is no build: `site/` is served as it is in the repo, so the bytes checked are the bytes deployed. WHAT IT CANNOT SEE: the shell scripts in scripts/ (no linter reads them), what Cloudflare actually serves (curl it), and the encrypted vault, which by design never touches this repo.
